The question at the heart of the novel
What would happen if every person had to live with the full consequences of the world they helped create?
From What If...? Food for Thought

A frustrated God. A sweeping new law. A nation that has to live with what it asked for.

In this provocative political and speculative fiction novel, a frustrated God watches a nation consumed by division, hatred, hypocrisy, and extremism. Determined to expose the consequences of intolerance, He inspires a sweeping new law that forces citizens to live under the very policies they support.

"Through interconnected stories, ordinary people confront justice, accountability, prejudice, faith, and redemption in ways they never imagined."

Five Lives. One Law.

Five interconnected stories. One question none of them can avoid.

As the new law reaches further into daily life, the Agents appear wherever belief is about to be tested: a pulpit, a porch, a roadside, a podium, a backyard full of family.

Faith

Preachers, their congregations never question their teachings for their souls. The agents will open their eyes and show them the pit of hell he is delivering their souls to.

Family

When hate is taught to a child, the agent teaches him the consequences.

Justice

Black men and women murdered by police, still in the year 2020.

Power

White people claim they were being treated like slaves. The agents are here to test their theory.

Ordinary Life

Black people live rent-free in a lot of white people's minds, while black people just want to live their lives in peace and love their children.

The Choice

Every story in this book leads back to the same door. Yours is next.

The Booth

One door. One box. The choice that starts every story in this book.
